one_line: Chaulukya king of Gujarat who forged power from Saurashtra to Malwa while patronizing scholars like Hemachandra.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and athletic with a seasoned warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown wheatish complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed full moustache with a short close beard along the jaw, default expression calm and composed with a subtle commanding intensity.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a mid-length topknot at the back of the head, sides smoothed back; he wears a simple conical golden crown-band (mukuta) with a small central green stone, fitted over the topknot and tied with a red cloth band at the back.
appearance.costume: Over his torso he wears a fitted quilted cotton coat (kanthi-type armor) in deep maroon with subtle vertical stitching and short, slightly flared sleeves reaching mid-bicep, fastened with a row of small bronze buttons; under this is a full-sleeved cream-coloured cotton tunic with a round neck and narrow cuffs; his lower body is wrapped in a knee-length, tightly tied off-white dhoti-style garment with a front pleat and maroon border, over which he wears a dark indigo cotton kachha-style under-wrap visible at the sides when he moves; around his waist is a broad leather war-belt dyed dark brown with a bronze buckle and a hanging knot of red cloth; he has a long, soft saffron-yellow angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its ends hanging near his right hip with a thin green border; he wears simple but elegant jewellery—medium-thickness gold hoops in both ears, a single short gold necklace with a small circular pendant, and two bronze bangles on his right wrist; his legs are covered by close-wrapped off-white cotton puttees from ankle to below the knee, and he wears sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes, suitable for riding and marching.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged steel sword (early talwar form) with a plain bronze hilt, a simple crossguard, and a brown leather-wrapped grip, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings hanging from his right hip on the war-belt; when unsheathed, the blade catches light with a clean polished sheen but has no ornamental engravings.

ref_desc: Jayasimha Siddharaja is a tall, athletic, wheatish-complexioned king with an oval face, black topknot under a simple conical golden crown-band, wearing a deep maroon quilted coat over a cream tunic, off-white dhoti with indigo under-wrap, saffron-yellow angavastra, brown leather belt and shoes, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a plain curved steel sword in a dark brown leather scabbard at his right hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Jayasimha Siddharaja: a tall, athletic, wheatish-complexioned Indian king in his late 30s with an oval face, straight nose, sharp dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed full moustache with short close beard, wearing thick black hair gathered into a mid-length topknot and a simple conical golden crown-band with a small central green stone, secured by a red cloth band at the back. Show him in a deep maroon quilted cotton coat with short sleeves over a long-sleeved cream tunic, an off-white knee-length dhoti with maroon border over a dark indigo under-wrap, a broad dark brown leather war-belt with bronze buckle, and a long saffron-yellow angavastra with green border draped from left shoulder to right hip. Include medium gold hoop earrings, a short gold necklace with a small round pendant, two bronze bangles on his right wrist, off-white leg puttees and sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. His signature weapon is a slightly curved single-edged steel sword with a plain bronze hilt and brown leather-wrapped grip, in a dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings hanging at his right hip; show both sheathed and unsheathed views. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, saffron yellow, cream, dark indigo and brown leather, and present him from front, side, and back to clearly display hair, face, costume, and weapon details.
